canonical_statement: For every finite-measure space, real-valued discrete-time martingale f, finite horizon n, and exponent 1 < p < infinity, the Lp seminorm of max_{0 <= k <= n} |f k| is at most (p/(p-1)) times the Lp seminorm of f n.
domain_and_universes: Omega : Type u; real-valued process f : Nat -> Omega -> Real; exponent p : ENNReal; horizon n : Nat; proposition in Prop
conclusion: eLpNorm (max_{k in range (n+1)} |f k|) p mu <= ofReal (p.toReal / (p.toReal - 1)) * eLpNorm (f n) p mu
index_convention: inclusive finite horizon k = 0,...,n; range (n+1) is nonempty even at n=0
